snippet.title: Football for the Bally Astrocade
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

???


Game description:

Football is a sports game for 2 or 4 (2 vs.2) players.

Inbetween the matches, the player gets the "plays" screen in which he (or she) can select the next style of play.


What I think:

Not bad, but not good either...The most annoying thing is that you have to wait till the computer moved down the cursor in "plays", even after you've selected you choice of play.
